title: Upper bound for the vertex count
statement: For nonnegative integers $K,c_0,m$, let $\ell(m)$ be the length of the binary expansion of $m+1$, and set $n_V(K,c_0,m)=2^{K(c_0+1)\ell(m)+(K+2)}$. Then \[n_V(K,c_0,m)\le 2^{K+2}\,2^{K(c_0+1)}(m+1)^{K(c_0+1)}.\]
